query:
SELECT b.binding_config,
                COALESCE(
                    (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(i.agent_type), '')
                     FROM connector_hosts i
                     WHERE i.bot_id = b.bot_id AND i.status = 'active'
                       AND i.revoked_at IS NULL
                     ORDER BY i.updated_at DESC
                     LIMIT 1),
                    NULLIF(TRIM(b.bridge_provider), ''),
                    'generic'
                ) AS agent_type
         FROM bot_accounts b
         WHERE b.bot_id = $1
